title: Atlas Shrugged
author: Ayn Rand
summary: As government rules choke American industry, the country's most capable producers begin vanishing one by one. A railroad executive fights to keep her family's company running while trying to understand why.
readIf: you want a huge, argumentative novel that mixes industry, romance and mystery in the service of one philosophy.
skipIf: you dislike long speeches and one-sided characters, since the book is over a thousand pages.

pairings.reason: The author's earlier novel and the more focused, character-driven account of her ideas.
A short, classic dystopia about state power from the opposite political direction.
A brief, sharp fable that makes its political point much faster and from a very different outlook.
